title: Support spell definitions
description: G8: global passive modifiers offered as a pick-1-of-3 on most level-ups, applying to whichever skill is equipped (slot-2/3 arrive in G9). Loaded identically by the Godot client; the Go server does not read this file today. See docs/0021.

schema_version.description: Bumped on any breaking change to this file's shape.

id.description: Stable snake_case identifier; never reused or renamed (persisted in save files).

family.description: 'stat' flows through PlayerStats.compose alongside equipment/level contributions; 'pipeline' (added_projectiles) changes the cast pipeline itself (game/scenes/player/player.gd). Purely documentation/UI metadata — both families are summed the same way by SupportCatalog.contribution_for_owned.

stat.description: Which PlayerStats.compose contribution key this support adds to; see game/domain/support_catalog.gd and game/domain/player_stats.gd for the exact math.

element.description: Required only for stat 'added_flat_damage': the damage's own hit only gains the flat amount when the equipped skill's element matches (docs/0021 — the single-damage-type-per-hit pipeline has no other channel to carry an off-element bonus).

value.description: Percentage for a '_pct' stat, a flat integer amount for added_flat_damage/life_on_kill/added_projectiles.
